MAJJI DURGA RAO Frontend & Full Stack Engineer | React.js • TypeScript • Node.js • Next.js • GraphQL Hyderabad, Telangana | 8817666164 | sde10durga@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/durgaraomajji | portfolio-gamma-two- 32ga8culbx.vercel.app | github.com/Durga00110

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Full stack engineer with 4.9 years of experience delivering 50% faster APIs, 30% faster page loads, and 60% more scalable platforms across Insurance, E-Commerce, and Government domains. Specializes in React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, and Redux, with hands-on experience in micro frontends, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and CI/CD-driven delivery. Comfortable owning a module end-to-end as SME, mentoring team members, and collaborating cross-functionally with QA, design, and product stakeholders.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 ● Frameworks & Libraries: React.js (Advanced), Next.js, Node.js, Redux, Redux Toolkit, React Native, Material UI (MUI), Bootstrap, Storybook

API & State Management: RESTful APIs, GraphQL, JWT, Data Access Layer (DAL) design ● Databases: MongoDB (Advanced), PostgreSQL, MSSQL, DynamoDB (Basics) ● Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, S3), Docker (Basics), CI/CD Pipelines, Datadog, Postman Enterprise

Testing & Quality: Jest, React Testing Library, Unit & Integration Testing, Code Reviews, OWASP Secure Coding ● Architecture: Micro Frontends, Design Systems, WCAG 2.1 AA / ARIA, Responsive Design, Performance Optimization

Tools: Git, GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Confluence, NX Console, Webpack, Vite, Claude, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot ● Collaboration & Leadership: Module Ownership (SME), Cross-functional Collaboration, Mentoring, Agile/Scrum Ceremonies, Stakeholder Communication

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Software Development Engineer | HTC Global Services | Hyderabad, Telangana Project: AMFAM Insurance Platform

Aug 2024 – Jun 2026

Owned the Third-Party Interest (TPI) module end-to-end as subject matter expert, coordinating with product, QA, and design stakeholders to ship stakeholder- and claim-management workflows in React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and GraphQL.

Improved application performance by 30% through code splitting, lazy loading, and React rendering optimizations, directly reducing page load time for enterprise insurance users.

Designed a scalable Node.js Data Access Layer (DAL) that cut API response times by 50% while decoupling services and simplifying downstream maintenance.

Built reusable, accessible UI components with Material UI (MUI), achieving WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, and drove a Jest / React Testing Library strategy that sustained 98%+ code coverage across the module.

Mentored junior engineers on component reuse and code-review standards, reducing rework flagged in review cycles.

Programmer Analyst | Bodex LLC | Bhilai, Chhattisgarh Project: The Blind Man — Next-Gen Sales Platform

Oct 2022 – Jul 2024

Built and maintained a cross-platform SaaS application on the MERN stack with MSSQL, React, and React Native, supporting field sales operations for enterprise clients.

Architected a Document Management System (DMS) with role-based access control that improved platform scalability by 60% while securing business-critical documents.

Designed RESTful APIs and reusable UI components, and implemented a RAG-based AI chatbot using Ollama that reduced manual lookup time for field reps by surfacing sales documentation through natural-language queries. ● Optimized rendering performance through code splitting and lazy loading, improving perceived load time on lower-

bandwidth field connections.

ICT Instructor | Centinel Spark Technologies Pvt. Ltd. | Hyderabad, Telangana Project: TSWRSEIS Government Platform

Jan 2021 – Dec 2021

● Developed responsive government and educational web applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Bootstrap,

improving accessibility for statewide student users.

Mentored students and delivered hands-on technical training in web development, robotics, and IoT, leading project- based learning cohorts.

KEY PROJECTS

Secure Authentication System

Built a Node.js + JWT authentication service with login, registration, and role-based access control (RBAC), following OWASP secure coding standards to prevent common vulnerabilities (injection, broken auth, insecure session handling).

DevPulse

Built a production-ready web application in Next.js and JavaScript demonstrating a reusable component architecture and route-level code splitting; deployed and actively maintained on Vercel (see portfolio link).

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering — Electronics & Telecommunication | May 2019 Chhattisgarh Swami Vivekanand Technical University, Bhilai

Higher Secondary (Class XII) | Mar 2015 | Gangotri Higher Secondary School, CGBSE Secondary School (Class X) | Mar 2013 | Vivekanand Higher Secondary School, CGBSE

CERTIFICATIONS

Atlassian Agile Project Management Professional Certificate ● Programming Foundations: Secure Coding ● Context Engineering Certification (Generative AI) ● Scrum: The Basics; Agile Foundations; Git Essential Training

ACHIEVEMENTS

Full Stack Web Development Internship — Best Performer Award (Edureka), Jan 2022 – Aug 2022
